[[2007 Copa Sudamericana|2007]]: [[Club Deportivo El Nacional|El Nacional]] |league topscorer = [[Luis Miguel Escalada]] (29 goals) |biggest home win = |biggest away win = |highest scoring = |matches =210 |total goals = 587 |longest wins = |longest unbeaten = |longest losses = |prevseason = [[2005 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A|2005]] |nextseason = [[2007 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A|2007]] }} The '''2006 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol de la Serie A''' (known as the '''2006 Copa Pílsener Serie A''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 48th season of Ecuador's [[Serie A de Ecuador|Serie A]], the country's top [[football (soccer)|football]] tournament for the country's top league. [[Club Deportivo El Nacional|El Nacional]] won their 13th title to tie [[Barcelona Sporting Club|Barcelona]] for the most top-flight championships in Ecuadorian football history. ==Format== The Serie A returned to its year-long format this season. The tournament was composed of three stages. The '''[[#First stage|First Stage]]''' and '''[[#Second stage|Second Stage]]''' are identical. The ten teams competed in a double [[round-robin tournament]], one game at home and one away. The top three teams in each stage qualified to the Liguilla Final with bonus points (3, 2, and 1 point[s], respectively). The winner of each group also qualified to the [[2006 Copa Sudamericana|2006]] and [[2007 Copa Sudamericana]], respectively. At the end of each, the team with the fewest points was relegated to the Serie B. The '''[[#Liguilla Final|Liguilla Final]]''' was a double round-robin tournament between the six qualified teams of the First and Second Stage. The winner of the Liguilla Final was crowned the Serie A champion.
